mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT prp.FACTORY_CODE, prp.MATERIAL_CODE, mpc.CONSTRUCTION_CODE, mpc.SPEC_CODE, mpc.EMBRYO_CODE, mpc.MOULD_METHOD, mpc.IS_ZERO_RACK, mpc.CURING_TIME, mpc.CURING_TIME2, mpc.MOULD_CAVITY, mpc.MOULD_CLAMPING_PRESSURE, mpc.EMBRYO_NO, mpc.LH_NO, mpc.TEXT_NO FROM t_dp_demand_plan prp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_sku_construction_ref mpc ON mpc.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE AND mpc.MATERIAL_CODE = prp.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL(mpc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
